preconditions.description: The number of records in the log is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each log line is non-empty and consists of space-separated tokens.

preconditions.expression: all(len(tokens) == 2 or len(tokens) == 1 for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each log line is either 'insert x', 'getMin x', or 'removeMin'.

preconditions.expression: all(tokens[0] in ['insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'] for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each log line starts with 'insert', 'getMin', or 'removeMin'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(tokens[1]) if len(tokens) == 2 else True for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: If a line has a number (insert/getMin), it is an integer between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is the integer m, the total number of operations in the corrected log, which is at least the original number of records.

postconditions.expression: all(line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The original log lines (excluding the first line) appear as a subsequence in the corrected log, preserving their order.
Each line in the corrected log is non-empty and consists of space-separated tokens.

postconditions.expression: all(len(tokens) == 2 or len(tokens) == 1 for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: Each line in the corrected log is either 'insert x', 'getMin x', or 'removeMin'.

postconditions.expression: all(tokens[0] in ['insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'] for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: Each line in the corrected log starts with 'insert', 'getMin', or 'removeMin'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(tokens[1]) if len(tokens) == 2 else True for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: If a line in the corrected log has a number (insert/getMin), it is an integer between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(int(tokens[1]) <= 10**9 and int(tokens[1]) >= -10**9 for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if len(line.strip().split()) == 2])
postconditions.description: All numbers in the corrected log are within the specified bounds.
The total number of operations in the corrected log does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(heap_min == int(tokens[1]) for tokens in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]] if tokens[0] == 'getMin')
postconditions.description: For every 'getMin x' operation in the corrected log, the minimum element in the heap at that point is exactly x.

postconditions.expression: all(heap_non_empty_before_op for op in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]] if op[0] in ['getMin', 'removeMin'])
postconditions.description: For every 'getMin' or 'removeMin' operation in the corrected log, the heap is non-empty immediately before the operation.

postconditions.expression: all(heap_after_op == heap_before_op - {min_val} if op[0] == 'removeMin' else heap_after_op == heap_before_op | {int(op[1])} if op[0] == 'insert' else True for op, heap_before_op, heap_after_op in zip([line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]], heap_states[:-1], heap_states[1:]))
postconditions.description: The heap state transitions in the corrected log are consistent with the operations: 'insert x' adds x, 'removeMin' removes the minimum, and 'getMin' does not modify the heap.
